item_short_desc: The Silva Starter Model 1-2-3 compass is the perfect beginner compass to understand working with maps and orienteering.
description: The Silva Starter Model 1-2-3 compass is the perfect beginner compass to understand working with maps and orienteering. The 2"x3" base plate is a great size for mapwork and is pocket-sized for convenient storage. The Lanyard hole allows you to wear the compass around your neck for quick and easy access when you are on the go.
